url: (File) Innowing 1 brainstorm area (1).jpg and Innowing 1 brainstorm area (2).jpg
title: brainstorm area
texts:
The photos show a modern, open brainstorm / small-auditorium area with stepped seating and a presentation wall. Key factual details:

Overall space and layout
- Open-plan room with a tiered platform (amphitheater-style) made of multiple wide steps rising against one wall. The tiers are rectangular and staggered, creating several seating levels.
- A large glass partition and glass door run along one side, revealing an adjacent meeting room with tables and chairs.
- A wide open floor in front of the tiers allows for flexible seating and circulation.

Surfaces, finishes and colors
- The tier faces combine light wood veneer and solid blue surfaces; top of each step is mostly a matte blue finish.
- A long low bench runs along the front of the tiers; the bench has teal/green upholstered cushions on a light wood base with open vertical supports.
- Several rows of cube pouf seats in bright colors (yellow, orange, red) are arranged on the floor in front of the tiers.
- Floor covering is light-grey carpet tiles with a subtle striped pattern.
- An angled wall graphic above the tiers features blue chevrons with white text reading “HKU ENGINEERING INNOVATION.”

Furniture and fixtures
- Integrated electrical sockets are visible on the vertical faces of the lower tiers.
- A white lectern/podium stands in front of a large wall display; the lectern has a small monitor on top.
- A freestanding fabric banner to the side carries the words “Innovation Academy” and a logo.
- The adjacent meeting room contains tables and chairs visible through the glass.

Technology and media
- A large video wall or LED screen is mounted on the wall opposite the tiers; it is displaying a video with a person on screen (face blurred in the photo).
- Overhead rectangular light panels provide general illumination.

Ceiling and services
- Exposed ceiling with visible ductwork and metal services; some areas of the ceiling are open and industrial in style.
- A suspended bulkhead painted a pale green spans above the seating area.

Other details
- The space reads as a multipurpose collaboration / presentation area with casual seating and stepped tiers suitable for group gatherings, talks or screenings.
- Signage and branded graphics indicate the space is affiliated with HKU Engineering / Innovation Academy.

url: (File) Innowing 1 gallery wall (1).jpg and Innowing 1 gallery wall (2).jpg
title: gallery wall
texts:
- Indoor corridor or lobby space with a continuous gallery wall that wraps around a corner, covering at least two adjoining wall faces.
- Wall surface is printed with a mosaic of photographs and captions arranged in rectangular panels; images include color and black-and-white photos, many showing groups of people and various buildings or interior scenes.
- Wall graphic color scheme includes gradients and blocks of teal, light blue, purple and white; some panels have thin horizontal graphic accents.
- The gallery panels are mounted at eye level and extend close to the floor; smaller caption labels or plaques are visible beneath many photos.
- Flooring consists of two different surfaces: a section of patterned grey carpet tiles with geometric linear designs and an adjacent smooth light-blue flooring strip that runs along the base of the gallery wall.
- A raised tactile guidance strip (truncated domes / linear tactile tiles) runs along the light-blue floor strip near the wall, indicating an accessibility feature.
- Ceiling has recessed rectangular panels and a track lighting system with adjustable spotlights aimed at the wall displays; there are also larger ceiling light fixtures providing diffuse illumination.
- A flat-panel monitor on a mobile stand with caster wheels is positioned near the corner of the gallery; cables and a small equipment tray are visible at its base.
- The upper ceiling near the corner shows a red-painted or red-finished section; other ceiling areas are white.
- Wall-mounted photos depict a variety of subjects, including group portraits, award presentations, building exteriors, and archival images; several photographs are arranged in rows and columns within each panel.
- The overall space appears organized for public viewing, with a clear pedestrian route along the gallery and unobstructed sightlines to the mounted images.

url: (File) Innowing 1 marketplace A (1).jpg and Innowing 1 marketplace A (2).jpg
title: marketplace A
texts:
Overall space
- Large, open-plan workshop or laboratory with a high, exposed ceiling showing ductwork, conduit, and cable trays.
- Smooth, light-grey floor (appears to be epoxy or polished concrete).
- Large rectangular recessed/flat-panel ceiling lights evenly distributed across the room.

Image 1 (wide view)
- Room furnished with multiple large rectangular wooden-topped worktables arranged in rows. Each table is paired with multiple backless stools (black metal legs, round seats).
- Several flat-panel monitors placed on some tables; other small items/boxes are visible on work surfaces and along the perimeter.
- Long banks of low counters and storage run along the left and far walls beneath large windows that look out onto green vegetation.
- At the far end of the room are additional benches and equipment along the perimeter, and more storage/cabinets.
- The space is well lit with daylight from the windows plus the ceiling lights; sightlines are unobstructed across most of the floor area.

Image 2 (closer view of one wall)
- Long countertop with a row of enclosed storage cabinets beneath; each cabinet door has a label or sticker (many are small yellow labels).
- On the countertop sit a row of five compact, box-like black machines or devices (uniform size/shape), plus a few smaller items and paperwork.
- Behind the countertop is a wide interior glass window/partition giving a view into an adjacent lab or workshop area; the glass shows reflections and silhouettes of people and equipment on the other side.
- A small stainless sink basin is partially visible in the counter area near the machines.
- The wall above the counter is painted white; there are electrical outlets and a narrow backsplash along the counter.
- The area is organized and appears set up for shared use, with labeled storage and work equipment accessible from the counter.

url: (File) Innowing 1 open event area (1).jpg and Innowing 1 open event area (2).jpg
title: open event area
texts:
Overall impression
- A modern, open-plan indoor event or workshop area with a high exposed ceiling and visible ductwork and conduits.
- Two-level view: one image taken from ground level looking toward a staircase and upper level, the other taken from above looking down onto the same space.

Flooring and ceiling
- Light grey, narrow-striped carpet covering the floor.
- Exposed ceiling with suspended rectangular LED light panels and visible HVAC ducts, cable trays and structural elements.

Furniture and layout
- Multiple white, modular tables with curved/triangular edges arranged into small clusters (typically seating 4–6 per cluster).
- Grey plastic shell chairs on metal legs paired with the tables.
- Tables have power cables and laptops on them; a few backpacks and personal items are on chairs and the floor.

Large objects and equipment
- A long, lightweight aircraft-like wing or model suspended diagonally above one part of the room.
- A large metal-framed apparatus or shelving unit along one wall (right side in the downward view) with multiple compartments and a transparent or mesh front.
- Mobile partition panels on wheels with hazard stripes in front of a glass stair balustrade.
- A flatscreen TV or monitor on a wheeled stand near an entrance/door in the background.

Circulation and architecture
- A wide glass balustrade staircase with red-colored underside or risers leading to an upper level visible from the space.
- An additional short black metal staircase or step element near the foreground in the overhead view.
- Doors and entrances along the far walls; some wall-mounted signage and small posters.

People and activity
- Several people seated at tables working on laptops; one person wearing headphones. No identifying details visible.
- Small groups and individual work setups, suggesting the space is used for study, collaboration, or small events.

Colors and materials
- Predominantly neutral palette: greys, whites, and metallic finishes with red accent on the stair structure and some blue-tinted glass surfaces.
- Materials include plastic (chairs), painted/laminate tabletops, metal framing, glass balustrades, and carpet tile flooring.

Additional details
- Small printed materials and flyers placed on tables.
- A few bright orange items (possibly safety gear or headphone sets) placed on tables or in a tray near the metal apparatus.
